title: Seville tour
text: Adrianna was an excellent guide and I would definitely recommend her.
author: wsoll

title: A lovely way to spend a few hours
text: We had a fantastic food tour with Cloti. It was my son’s birthday and she had brought candles for his age, balloons and bubbles (for both him and his sister), it was so thoughtful. I asked for a couple of sweet spots to be included on the tour and we had churros and took home some cookies! We also went to a traditional Freiduria and ate Gambas fritas, chipirones fritos and adobe, had a huge selection of croquettes, some traditional cakes and a couple of soft drinks/ coffee.
author: LKP2019

title: Alba was an amazing guide!
text: Alba was an amazing guide. We got a great overview of the history of Seville as well as insight into the culture.
author: Allison_D

title: Family trip in Seville
text: This was a lovely walking tour of Seville. We were shown the main sights plus a number of hidden hems. There were also a number of stories and legends that the tour guide shared which we enjoyed. I would recommend the tour to other travelers.
author: Yvonne_K

title: Fabulous experience of Seville’s hidden gems! Cannot recommend highly enough!
text: The whole experience from start to finish was an absolute pleasure. City Unscripted were very efficient and took care to find out exactly what we were interested in seeing and doing during the experience. They matched us with Alba who was a fabulous host. She was super warm and friendly and had an amazing knowledge of the city and all the little hidden gems. She showed us little plazas, alleyways, churches and really brought the city to life. She brilliantly combined the more official history of Seville with lots of stories about local people and  how they lived, I was with my very discerning
author: Excursion63254526965

title: Bringing Sevilla’s History to Life
text: Adriana was fantastic! She brought the history of Sevilla to life with engaging stories and a vibrant energy that kept us all captivated . It was a memorable experience!
author: MerisWorld

title: A wonderful way to get to know Seville
text: Tina was awesome and, of course, being a native of Seville, showed us the real city. As the locals enjoy it. We sampled good cuisine, Spanish beer and olives. This was one of the most enjoyable ways to experience Seville.  Best 3 hours we spent. Thanks Tina!
author: erichA6677EW

title: A superb tour from a knowledgeable, friendly local
text: City Unscripted continues to deliver.  Pablo was the perfect guide: Seville-born and passionate about his city, he also studied history and so has an exceptionally deep knowledge about Seville and Spain, with a smart sense of humour.  Our tour was well paced and varied, which gave us an excellent sense of the city that helped us in the days that followed.  Add that Pablo gave us superb recommendations, and we feel that a big part of why we loved our visit to Seville, was thanks to him!
author: mikemZ8643FA

title: Good time in Sevilla
text: My guide Tina was like a friend, accommodating and caring. We strolled the Barrio Santa Cruz and shopped for turron and enjoyed lunch. She walked to my pace and preferences.
author: virginia y

title: Waking tour of Sevilla, Spain.
text: Alba, from Tours With Locals, was so knowledgeable of the history of Sevilla and delivered it in a great and fluid way.  Nothing seemed scripted and she was able to answer any questions that we had.  Highly recommend touring Sevilla with Alba.  Her English is impeccable.  She went over the 3-hour time of the tour and also did it on a Sunday.  Thank you, Alba!
author: James C
